paragraph: Admission is a single store.lock critical section at create_batch. Exactly one active batch is held (pending/running or executing). A second HTTP caller on a different fingerprint gets BatchBusy → 409; an identical fingerprint attaches and create_and_run returns without starting a second runner. step_batch claims one index under the same lock; a concurrent stepper persists step_ignored=already_executing and does not analyse. Cancel sets cancel_requested but keeps admission held while executing is true; the guard releases on success, failure, and only after executing becomes false. Process model is single_process_per_data_dir, enforced by the launcher .runtime.lock. Batch admission never consults the acquisition grant.
